name: MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 AI (Magnetic, UV Coated) - Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 AI (Magnetic, UV Coated) - Bluetooth Smart Cube puts a glossy, high-grip UV Coated finish (MoYu calls it Magic Coated) on the 48-magnet AoLong V5 AI. It syncs with the WCU CUBE app for timing, coaching, and online play, and lasts about 300 hours per charge.
features: UV Coated grip: Super glossy plastic with high grip, for cubers who prefer a coated feel over matte.
Auto timing in the app: Press and hold to start the WCU CUBE smart timer, then get an AI breakdown of individual solves afterward.
Coaching while you practice: The AI assistant gives instant corrections as you go, and post-solve reports point out where to focus next.
Online battles: Ranked PvP, multiplayer battles, and club teams put you up against cubers worldwide.
Charge and go: About 300 hours of use per charge (MoYu lab testing), on a dock you simply set the cube on.
Digital Dual Adjustment System: Two independent settings, elasticity and tension, that change quickly and precisely.
